description.narrative: (Egypt): Workforce Egypt's primary goal is to transform Egypt's technical education and vocational training system to provide the skills needed for a globally competitive Egyptian market, creating sustainable jobs, especially for youth and women, and institutionalizing structural labor market reforms that can support workforce development. This activity will achieve consistently higher quality and technically relevant training, enhance private sector engagement and public-private cooperation to improve human resources strategies at the firm-level, and improve the policy and operating environment for market-driven skills development and job growth. This will be achieved by: 1) providing technical assistance, capacity building and training to relevant stakeholders and counterparts, including the Ministry of Education and Technical Education (MOETE), technical schools, the quality assurance and accreditation authority, training institutions, private sector firms, NGOs, and business associations; 2) establishing partnerships between businesses and MOETE at all levels; improve and promote innovation in the provision of workforce development and vocational training programs; 3) upgrading and improving curricula of select secondary technical educational programs including the digitization of those curricula; 4) upgrading the skills of teachers and administrators; 5) establishing or upgrading a number of technical schools to meet international standards by providing funding for equipment and tools and establishing alliances between USAID and select private sector firms and associations; and, 6) advocating for policy and regulatory reforms relating to labor market efficiency and human capital development at the governorate and national levels. This activity will also improve human resources management, and youth and women's employment practices in the private sector to improve retention in the workforce..
